decisions.choice: Specify mathematical structures and satisfaction separately in DENOTATION.md before implementing evaluator controls

decisions.basis: No missing-data-to-false shortcut or partial-function default
decisions.choice: Models must interpret exactly every canonical sort/constant/function/predicate; function tuple coverage is total and checked without materializing a Cartesian-product list

decisions.basis: These are execution/model states, not logical falsehood
decisions.choice: Expose malformed, unsupported, cancelled and resource-limit outcomes without a truth value

decisions.basis: C01 composition integrity is independent from self-declared hashes
decisions.choice: Require separately selected input IRs/alignment refs for evaluating a composed signature

decisions.basis: A target is never automatically inserted into T
decisions.choice: Evaluate T, required populations and targets separately under one complete structure

obligation_coverage: All C02 implementation/semantic control criteria mapped; universal evaluator correctness and source fidelity remain separate unproved obligations.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Hand-derived models, empty domains, alias/subtype/overlap controls and parser correspondence checked; no StaticConforms := checker=true as semantic specification.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Define model satisfaction independently from Boolean acceptance; evaluate each supported AST node under an explicit environment and domain; separate T from queried obligations and populations.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Hand-derived models, empty domains, alias/subtype/overlap controls and parser correspondence checked; no StaticConforms := checker=true as semantic specification.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
